source.title_or_context: Recommendations for the management of prosthetic heart valves

table_assessment.assessment_notes: Exact review shows a medication-dominant anticoagulation table with VKA, UFH, LMWH, warfarin, phenprocoumon, and acenocoumarol instructions, mixed with valve-prosthesis selection, delivery, and echocardiography instructions. The corrected primary class is medication recommendation, with mixed row content preventing table-example readiness.

normative_assertions.notes: Valve-prosthesis selection is to occur in consultation with the pregnancy heart team.

text_units.verbatim_text: It is recommended that the valve prosthesis for a woman contemplating pregnancy is chosen in consultation with a pregnancy heart team.

normative_assertions.notes: Pregnancy management is recommended in a centre with a pregnancy heart team.

text_units.verbatim_text: It is recommended to manage pregnancy in women with mechanical valves in a centre with a pregnancy heart team.

entities.surface_form: delivery starts while on a VKA or in less than 2 weeks after discontinuation of a VKA

normative_assertions.notes: Caesarean section is conditional on delivery beginning during or soon after VKA use.

text_units.verbatim_text: If delivery starts while on a VKA or in less than 2 weeks after discontinuation of a VKA, caesarean section is recommended.

normative_assertions.notes: VKA discontinuation is timed to week 36.
Adjusted-dose UFH or LMWH is started as the replacement.

text_units.verbatim_text: It is recommended to discontinue VKAs and start adjusted-dose intravenous UFH (aPTT ≥2× control) or adjusted-dose LMWHc (see separate recommendations) at the 36th week of gestation.

entities.surface_form: pregnant women on LMWH or UFH

normative_assertions.notes: Weekly anti-Xa or aPTT monitoring is coupled with dose adjustment within 36 hours.

text_units.verbatim_text: In pregnant women on LMWH or UFH, it is recommended to perform weekly anti-Xa level monitoring or aPTT monitoring with dose adjustment (within 36 h).

normative_assertions.notes: INR monitoring frequency is explicit.

text_units.verbatim_text: In pregnant women on a VKA, it is recommended to perform INR monitoring weekly or every 2 weeks.

normative_assertions.notes: The post-dose timing and valve-specific target ranges are retained.

text_units.verbatim_text: In pregnant women with LMWH, it is recommended to target anti-Xa levels 4–6 h post-dose at 0.8–1.2 U/l (aortic valve prosthesis) or 1.0–1.2 IU/mL (mitral and right-sided valve prostheses).

entities.surface_form: at least 36 h before planned delivery

normative_assertions.notes: LMWH is replaced with intravenous UFH before planned delivery.
UFH continues until the specified pre-delivery time.
UFH restart is conditional on absence of bleeding complications.

text_units.verbatim_text: It is recommended to replace LMWH with intravenous UFH (aPTT ≥2× control) at least 36 h before planned delivery. UFH should be continued until 4–6 h before planned delivery and restarted 4–6 h after delivery if there are no bleeding complications.

normative_assertions.notes: Delivery timing is planned to support peripartum anticoagulation.

text_units.verbatim_text: It is recommended to anticipate the timing of delivery to ensure safe and effective peripartum anticoagulation.

normative_assertions.notes: Immediate timing is part of the test target.

text_units.verbatim_text: Immediate echocardiography is recommended in women with mechanical valves presenting with dyspnoea and/or an embolic event.

normative_assertions.notes: Regimen changes during pregnancy are to be implemented in hospital.

text_units.verbatim_text: It is recommended to implement changes in the anticoagulation regimen during pregnancy in hospital.

entities.surface_form: second and third trimesters until the 36th week

normative_assertions.notes: VKA use is tied to both dose need and gestational interval.

text_units.verbatim_text: During the second and third trimesters until the 36th week, VKAs are recommended in women needing a low dose.

normative_assertions.notes: The exact row entails consideration of a bioprosthesis but does not state the implantation verb.

text_units.verbatim_text: A bioprostheses should be considered in young women contemplating pregnancy.

entities.surface_form: second and third trimesters until the 36th week

normative_assertions.notes: VKA use is tied to high-dose need and the specified gestational interval.

text_units.verbatim_text: During the second and third trimesters until the 36th week, VKAs should be considered in women needing a high dose.

entities.surface_form: warfarin dose required for therapeutic anticoagulation is <5 mg/day (or phenprocoumon <3 mg/day or acenocoumarol <2 mg/day)

normative_assertions.notes: Continuation depends on the stated dose thresholds and follows patient information and consent.

text_units.verbatim_text: Continuation of VKAs should be considered during the first trimester if the warfarin dose required for therapeutic anticoagulation is <5 mg/day (or phenprocoumon <3 mg/day or acenocoumarol <2 mg/day) after patient information and consent.

entities.surface_form: patients with a warfarin dose >5 mg/day (or phenprocoumon >3 mg/day or acenocoumarol >2 mg/day)

normative_assertions.notes: VKA discontinuation is advised between weeks 6 and 12 for the stated dose profile.
Replacement uses adjusted-dose UFH or twice-daily adjusted-dose LMWH.

text_units.verbatim_text: Discontinuation of VKAs between weeks 6 and 12, and replacement with adjusted-dose intravenous UFH (aPTT ≥2× control) or adjusted-dose LMWHc twice daily (see separate recommendations), should be considered in patients with a warfarin dose >5 mg/day (or phenprocoumon >3 mg/day or acenocoumarol >2 mg/day).

entities.surface_form: anti-Xa level monitoring and dose adjustment
women who need a high dose of VKA

normative_assertions.notes: LMWH use includes anti-Xa monitoring/dose adjustment and follows patient information and consent.

text_units.verbatim_text: During the second and third trimesters, LMWHc with anti-Xa level monitoring and dose adjustment (see separate recommendations) may be considered in women who need a high dose of VKAe after patient information and consent.

normative_assertions.notes: Pre-dose monitoring is added to peak monitoring at the stated threshold.

text_units.verbatim_text: In pregnant women with LMWH, in addition to monitoring peak anti-Xa levels, monitoring pre-dose levels targeted at ≥0.6 IU/mL may be considered.

entities.surface_form: weekly anti-Xa level monitoring and dose-adjustment is not available

normative_assertions.notes: LMWH administration is recommended against when required monitoring and adjustment are unavailable.

text_units.verbatim_text: LMWH is not recommended when weekly anti-Xa level monitoring and dose-adjustment is not available.
